author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.10.0 — Adds lastRunCompleteness: a rough % readout of how much of a room-clean batch's total expected time actually elapsed, computed from the sum of each targeted room's learned/estimated clean time vs. actual elapsed minutes. Distinct from per-room crediting -- gives a coarse 'how effective was this run' signal without needing a completion record for every room.
